description:
Read the properties and relationships of microsoft.graph.teamsAdministration.numberAssignment object.

TIP: Lists telephone number assignments for Teams. Shows which phone numbers are assigned to which users or resources. Look up one number with $filter=telephoneNumber eq '+15145551234'; every field except id and city is filterable (e.g. assignmentStatus eq 'unassigned', numberType eq 'directRouting'). Default page is 500, max $top is 1000.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-teams-phone-assignments
